facts.text: Under the Halfling Corps terms, Trout owes Squints second pick of treasure, after the elite members, once the first treasure is won. Until then Squints funds himself.

Squints, armed with a sling and a dagger and a more experienced fighter than Trout, has joined Trout's Halfling Corps as a junior assistant. He takes Trout's orders, fights monsters, supplies his own gear and funds himself until the first treasure.
